summary: This SEC Form 6-K filed by NatWest Group plc reports a routine director/PDMR shareholding disclosure under the UK Market Abuse Regulation. An interim chief risk officer sold 35,328 ordinary shares at £6.5700 per share on the London Stock Exchange. There are no special-situation events such as acquisitions, activist campaigns, restructuring, or strategic reviews. The filing is a standard regulatory notification of insider trading and does not involve any corporate transaction or material reorganization. Accordingly, it does not meet the criteria for a special-situations category.
